popupNoVideo.message: No YouTube video in this tab.

profileHelp.message: Fast keeps every cached result, takes YouTube's captions and the model from the settings. Thorough redoes every step, transcribes with the large Whisper and asks the strongest model the backend has.

timestampsHelp.message: Link every section and picture to its moment in the video.

condensedHelp.message: Boil the video down to a two-minute read.

cleanupHelp.message: Remove the intermediate files under work/ once the outputs are written.

noEstimate.message: No earlier run to estimate from.

noServiceHelp.message: Start it in a terminal, then press Connect in the settings:

noAccess.message: No access to the local service yet.

noAccessHelp.message: video-tldr talks to a service on your own machine, at 127.0.0.1. Nothing else is reached. Allow it once, and this window keeps working.

welcomeIntro.message: A small service runs on this machine and does all the work: fetching the video, transcribing it, handing it to a language model.

welcomeScriptHelp.message: Picks the CUDA libraries when an NVIDIA card is present. Otherwise the smaller ONNX runtime is used.

welcomeUvHelp.message: The shortest way for anyone who already has `uv` on the machine — as soon as the package is published to PyPI.

welcomeThen.message: `video-tldr serve` starts the service. `video-tldr autostart on` has it start at every logon instead. Then open a YouTube video and click the toolbar icon — the first click asks once for access to `127.0.0.1`.

restartServiceHelp.message: Starts the service fresh. Worth a try when a light stays red although the machine is fine: a process that lost its graphics card at the wrong moment keeps that loss until it is started again.

restartSlow.message: the service is not back yet; press Connect in a moment

token.message: Token (only if the service has one)

tokenPlaceholder.message: empty unless config.json sets a token

languageOfNote.message: Language the summary is written in

languageHelp.message: The note, its sections and captions come out in this language. Quotes and technical terms stay as spoken in the video.

styleHelp.message: How the note is worded. "all" writes one note per style, for comparing them.

outputs.message: Outputs besides the summary (none chosen falls back to md)

downloadDirHelp.message: Empty means your browser's download folder, shown in grey.

obsidianFolder.message: Folder in the vault for the notes

browserForPdf.message: Chrome or Edge for the PDF

browserHelp.message: Empty means the one the service found on this machine, shown in grey.

pdfTemplateHelp.message: An HTML file with a {{content}} placeholder, or a CSS file. Empty means the built-in look.

modelHelp.message: Reads the transcript and writes the note. Choose where it runs (the backend) and which model there; Thorough asks for the strongest model of the backend instead.

keyNote.message: Stars stand for a stored key; leave them to keep it, clear the field to remove it.

openaiBaseUrlHelp.message: Empty means OpenAI itself. Enter an address to reach a compatible server instead, for example Azure OpenAI, OpenRouter or one on this machine. It serves the language model and the openai transcriber alike.

sttHelp.message: Turns the audio into text, and only runs when YouTube has no captions or when a model is chosen here instead of auto. These models run on this machine or at OpenAI; they are not language models and cannot write the note. Thorough always transcribes with whisper-large.

statsEmpty.message: No run yet; the first video fills this in.

statsConnect.message: Connect to see what your runs took.

benchHelp.message: Runs the same video through several models of the current backend and compares what each took.

blocklist.message: Open all links: blocked hosts, one per line (subdomains included)

helpBackendClaude.message: The Claude Code CLI on your subscription: no key, no extra bill, reads pictures, finds every link. The best choice unless you want to stay offline.

helpBackendAnthropic.message: The Anthropic API, paid per token; needs the key below. Same models as claude, without the subscription.

helpBackendOpenai.message: The OpenAI API, paid per token; needs the key below.

helpBackendLmstudio.message: Your own model in LM Studio, free and offline. Load it with a context of 32768 or more, and pick a vision model if you want labelled pictures.

helpBackendOllama.message: Your own model in Ollama, free and offline. Give it a context of 32768 or more; `ollama pull` a vision model for labelled pictures.

modelAdvice.message: Good: a vision model (LM Studio calls it vlm) with 32768 tokens of context or more. Poor: a Whisper or embedding model, which cannot write at all; a model under 32768 tokens, which runs out mid-transcript; a heavily quantised one, which is eight times slower here.

checkModelHelp.message: Asks the backend now, with what stands here: whether the server answers, whether it takes the key, and whether the model reads pictures. Better to find out here than in the middle of a run.

historyHelp.message: What your own runs took on this machine. Medians over the runs that really did the step.

welcomeSourceHelp.message: Works before any release exists. After cloning: `npm ci && npm run build` for the extension, `uv sync --project service --extra gpu` for the service.

welcomeHeading.message: One half is installed. Here is the other.
